description: Fetch the YouTube homepage video feed (the ranked recommendation stream at youtube.com), as a substitute for the Trending page which redirects to the homepage in some regions. The homepage has a filter chip bar (e.g. 全部/音乐/直播/播客/最近上传/发现新视频) whose tabs are personalized and change over time — pass any tab text and the command matches it against the live chip bar; on mismatch it errors and lists the tabs currently available. Returns video cards with title, channel, view count, publish time, duration, and URL. Scrolls internally up to the limit (max 100); partial=true when the stream ends early. No authentication required.

parameters.name: tab
parameters.description: Homepage filter chip text to match, e.g. "全部" (default), "音乐", "直播", "播客", "最近上传". These chips are personalized per account/session — the examples are common values, not a fixed enum. If the text doesn't match any live chip, the command fails and lists the chips currently present on the page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of videos to return (1-100, default 20). The feed lazy-loads on scroll; the command scrolls until the limit is reached or the stream is exhausted (partial=true).
